Valus/About

What is Valus?

Free preparation for every HOSA student

Valus is a study space for high school students competing in HOSA–Future Health Professionals. Our mission is simple: support every competitor, wherever they’re from, at no cost.

Start studying free

Our principles

  • Free, always

    Every lesson, practice set, and study tool for students is free. No premium tier, no paywall between you and your event.

  • Built for one event

    HOSA students compete in one event a year. Valus is shaped around that single focus instead of spreading you thin.

  • For every chapter

    Instructors get assignments, progress views, and a private chapter space at no cost, so any school can take part.

Why it matters

Some chapters have years of study materials and experienced advisors. Others are starting from scratch. Valus exists so that a future health professional’s preparation depends on their effort, not their budget.

Lessons and practice tests are written for Valus from the references named in each event’s official guidelines, with openly licensed textbook material such as OpenStax where it helps.

Valus is an independent study project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by HOSA–Future Health Professionals. Always confirm requirements in the current official guidelines and with your chapter advisor.
